text.en: Customers highlight polite, welcoming communication from the salon staff. Reviewers note that the team is easy to interact with, readily acknowledges patron inquiries, and maintains a polite, community-oriented attitude toward neighborhood pet owners seeking dependable grooming care.

Pet owners consistently describe the staff as courteous, accommodating, and hardworking. Reviewers appreciate the attentive service during drop-off and pickup, with multiple clients recommending the shop for reliable routine grooming and general pet supplies in the neighborhood.

Multiple reviewers express appreciation for how gently their dogs are handled during appointments. Pet parents of doodles and other breeds highlight that staff members treat animals kindly, ensuring dogs stay relaxed and come home happy after their baths and trim sessions.

q.en: Does the business offer pet supplies as well as grooming?

a.en: Yes, the location operates as both a pet shop and a grooming salon for neighborhood pet parents.

q.en: What types of dogs do they groom?

a.en: Customer feedback indicates that the salon grooms various breeds, including doodles and family dogs.

q.en: Do customers recommend booking in advance?

a.en: Yes, clients advise calling ahead to schedule grooming appointments and confirm groomer availability.
